prompt: Write a complete Arduino sketch (sketch.ino) for an Arduino Uno (arduino:avr core 1.8.6). Open Serial at 9600 baud. Read newline-terminated commands: ON sets pin 13 HIGH, OFF sets it LOW, anything else prints ERR followed by a newline. Reply OK after a valid command. Read without blocking: check Serial.available() and buffer characters until the newline. Use only the core; no libraries.
